annotation.title_en: The New Way to Catch a Mouse
annotation.summary_en: A woman frantically tries to hide her lover when her husband returns home early, leading to a bizarre excuse involving a mouse and a white sack.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch begins with a frantic scene in an apartment where a woman wearing a red robe is seen rushing between the bedroom and the stairwell. A shirtless man is lounging in her bed, and they engage in a brief, chaotic interaction involving a pillow. The tension rises as the woman realizes her husband has returned home unexpectedly early. In the hallway, she encounters her husband, a man dressed in a formal suit and carrying a briefcase. He praises himself for being a good husband who provided the car and the home renovations, noting his punctual work schedule. However, he catches her in a state of disarray. To explain the presence of another man or the general chaos, a bizarre plan is hatched involving a large white sack (or coat). The husband forces the white garment over the woman's head, claiming it is a 'new way' to drive a mouse out of the house by shouting 'ksh-ksh' at it. The sketch ends with a meta-joke when the hidden lover, instead of fleeing, asks why the husband isn't leaving yet, as he is interested in this mouse-catching method for his own home.
catchphrases: ինչի չես գնում մեր տանն էլ մուկ կա ինձելա հետաքրքիր
